label: Role-play — a game server with in-game proximity voice
summary: An in-game channel the game drives (positions, radio, phone), out-of-character rooms, support and staff.
notes: The Ingame password goes into the game resource's server config (sdk/fivem-voipc/server_config.lua, channelPassword), the game_token into the game server's VoIPC settings — never in front of players. See docs/SDK.md.
Factions — police, medics, gangs — usually want rooms of their own: add one per faction, each with a password.
Posting in an announcement channel takes an admin (the admin token) or, on a server with accounts, a moderator.

channels.name: welcome
channels.description: Rules, how to connect your game, and how whitelisting works. Only staff post here.

channels.description: Restarts, updates and wipes. Only staff post here.

channels.name: Ingame
channels.description: In-character voice, driven by the game: join it from inside the game, not from here. Where you stand decides who hears you; radio and phone work inside it.
